I was unable to land the required source edit. Every str_replace attempt against django/contrib/admin/options.py was rejected with "old_str equals new_str" — the tool reported no confirmed change, so the file on disk remains at revision 668c0e573b953d10c221c6ffbe72b098b9e4e957ae02bcc22abfe20ad36d1bb3, unmodified.

Intended fix (not applied): in ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed(), the relation-part accumulation condition

    if not prev_field or (
        prev_field.is_relation
        and field not in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields
    ):
        relation_parts.append(part)

incorrectly treats a relation field that is also a primary key (e.g. Restaurant.place, a OneToOneField with primary_key=True) as a concrete parent, so the lookup restaurant__place__country gets collapsed to restaurant__country, which is not in list_filter, and lookup_allowed() returns False. The fix is to also append the part when the field itself is a relation, e.g.:

    if not prev_field or (
        prev_field.is_relation
        and field not in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields
    ) or field.is_relation:
        relation_parts.append(part)

Verification status: the public regression selection (modeladmin, 162 tests) reports passed, but that result is cached from the unchanged revision and does NOT reflect any edit — no change was written to disk. The host feature acceptance for test_lookup_allowed_foreign_primary is therefore expected to still fail (AssertionError: False is not True). This task is incomplete: the target behavior was not fixed because no edit could be committed within the available request budget.
